text:
alex m: Heads-up — PMs pushed a customer-driven ask: staged, tenant-prioritized rollout for the new routing optimizer flag. Need a bake plan (slices, gating metrics, fallback). Who can sketch a minimal safe v1?
Maya P: +1. propose slices: 1) internal/dev, 2) pilot customers (10 orgs), 3) opt-in beta (5%), 4) broad (region-by-region). Keep regions: us-west, eu-west, ap-sg.
Sergio (infra): Capacity note — the optimizer increases call-count to cache priming. We should limit initial QPS per shard and pre-warm KV caches. Autoscale bump for pilot windows.
Jen - PM: Launch criteria suggestions: p95 latency delta <= +150ms vs baseline; error spike <= 0.5% absolute; routing correctness (business metric) >= 98% of baseline on our eval set; no customer-facing exceptions for 48h in pilot. Also need rollout duration and escalation path.
Samir (data): For A/B signal: primary metric = end-to-end success rate (customer conversion proxy), secondary = p95 latency, tertiary = model-quality score from eval prompts. Sample sizes: pilot should give ~2000 requests/day to be meaningful (so pick tenants accordingly).
alex m: Good. For fallback policy: immediate toggle to previous variant if error spike > x or latency > y for 10m sustained. Agree on thresholds?
Maya P: Suggest thresholds: error spike > 2x baseline OR absolute +1% error for 10m. Latency: p95 > baseline +300ms sustained 10m. Also circuit-breaker: if regional error > 5% for 5m, cut region.
Sergio (infra): Implement automated rollback hook in the router: when telemetry meets trigger, route all affected slices to the pinned stable variant and throttle new joiners. We can use existing flag switch with immediate effect. Need owners for runbooks.
Samir (data): A/B config idea — run holdout by tenant (split) rather than per-request. That avoids KV cache cross-talk. Otherwise request-level split will skew caches.
Jen - PM: Scope negotiation: v1 should be feature-flag + tenant-sliced A/B + automated rollback triggers + telemetry dashboard. Leave multi-variant rollout and percent-based progressive tuning for v2. Agree?
alex m: agree. Keep v1 small — we want safety not bells. Can someone draft the flag config?
Maya P: Draft config (yaml):
```
feature_flag:
  name: route_opt_v1
  slices:
    - name: internal
      type: whitelist
      tenants: [redwood-int, test-acct1]
    - name: pilot
      type: tenant_sample
      tenants_count: 10
    - name: beta_open
      type: pct
      pct: 5
  regions: [us-west, eu-west, ap-sg]
  gates:
    metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, routing_accuracy]
    window: 10m
```
Maya P: Add note: pilot tenants should be chosen to represent small/med/large orgs.
Sergio (infra): Ops checklist: pre-warm KV for pilot tenants (script: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --tenants pilot`), increase GPU warm workers +20% for first 2h, monitor RPC queue length and backpressure.
Samir (data): Instrumentation: tag traces with slice and tenant, emit shard-level p95, and routing accuracy telemetry. Need a small eval harness to run golden prompts across pilot tenants hourly.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: route_opt_v1 -> pilot (10 tenants) on 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. Canary window: 48h. Auto-rollback hooks enabled.
Jen - PM: Owners: Maya -> rollout owner, Sergio -> infra runbook, Samir -> metrics/analysis, Alex -> tie to customer comms + opt-in list.
alex m: Timeline: this week finalize pilot tenant list and flag YAML. next week schedule dry-run in staging and KV warm script test. Send final opt-in invites 24h before deploy.
Maya P: I'll post pilot tenant nominations by EOD.
Sergio (infra): I'll add the rollback automation and update the runbook.
Samir (data): I'll produce the evaluation dashboard and the hourly golden-run job.
Jen - PM: Sweet. Quick decisions captured: v1 scope small, tenant slices, tenant-level A/B, explicit thresholds for auto-fallback, region circuit-breaker. If no objections by EOD we'll lock and create the launch ticket. :thumbsup:
alex m: Thanks — will follow up with the launch ticket and a short shiproom sync invite. :rocket:
